name: Ōharu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōharu town emblem in navy: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing the character 治.
history: Municipal flag of Ōharu, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ōharu town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing the character 治
